name: Vlog Platform
subtitle: Camera ready. Confidence optional.
description: A tiny film school, where your first vlog is allowed to be gloriously imperfect.

name: Arcade Carriage
subtitle: Terrible prizes. Excellent nonsense.
description: Three games are being fitted into the carriage. The management has already misplaced the high scores.

name: Post Office
subtitle: Some things travel better on paper.
description: A wooden counter, postcards, a stamp passport and a letter box waiting for the right words.

name: Chai Stall
subtitle: Any kind of day is welcome.
description: A quiet counter for great days, ordinary days, difficult days, and the ones that need extra chai.

name: Quiet Carriage
subtitle: No timetable. No expectations.
description: Just a window, gentle rain and the permission to do absolutely nothing for a while.

name: Last Station
subtitle: The destination was never the point.
description: This place doesn't expire. Come back tomorrow, or in six months. The chai stall will still be here.
